_comment: Toxic Chain collection. Each name in 'lines' brings in its WHOLE evolutionary line. The 18 lines were picked with `generate.py pick --count 18 --seed toxic-chain-mochi` (lines may be shared with other collections since #24), then given a look each (three lines per look). Shared look in styles/_toxic.py.

readme.title: Toxic Chain
readme.summary: Pokemon bound by poisonous chains and mochi (after Pecharunt's Toxic Chain).
looks: each line wears one look: dark violet bound with glowing magenta chains (Darkrai, Duraludon, Dondozo); glossy lilac toxic mochi (Audino, Chimecho, Castform); toxic ooze dripping from the top (Tadbulb, Orthworm, Flamigo); bubbling green-and-purple sludge (Teddiursa, Turtwig, Stunfisk); glowing venom veins that pulse (Dratini, Meditite, Emolga); swirling poison gas (Meloetta, Volbeat, Poltchageist)
the poison glows in the dark: chains throb, drips run, bubbles pop, veins pulse, gas swirls; glowing magenta eyes
shiny: the poison turned round the colour wheel
